ping.searchCountryCityOneOnlineProbeSele: Search by country or city. One online probe is selected per city, up to 50 custom cities.
ping.optimizedModePrioritizes2MainlandCh: Optimized mode prioritizes 2 mainland China cities for comparison. Other regions favor major cloud providers, falling back to online nodes. Global mode adds up to 2 per continent; single-continent mode adds up to 5. Identical combinations reuse results for 60 seconds. A failed ping alone does not prove censorship.

webrtc.browserDoesSupportWebrtcSoCheckCa: This browser does not support WebRTC, so the check cannot run.
webrtc.publicCandidateAddressCollectedBr: No public candidate address collected. Browser restrictions, UDP blocking or disabled WebRTC may be responsible; this does not establish safety.
webrtc.udpEgressCollectedButHttpBaseline: UDP egress collected, but the HTTP baseline failed. Cannot determine whether they match.
webrtc.udpAddressDiffersHttpEgressCheckP: A UDP address differs from HTTP egress. Check your proxy routing rules; different egress does not necessarily mean a leak.
webrtc.theSampledPublicUdpEgressMatchesH: The sampled public UDP egress matches HTTP egress.
webrtc.webrtcUsesIceStunDiscoverAddresse: WebRTC uses ICE/STUN to discover addresses for peer-to-peer connections. STUN usually uses UDP. If a proxy handles only TCP, candidates may expose another public egress. This page creates only a data channel and does not request camera or microphone permission.
webrtc.udpConnectionlessTransportProtoco: UDP is a connectionless transport protocol. A STUN server returns the public mapped address it observes to the client. This tool uses Google and Cloudflare STUN, collects ICE candidates and compares them with HTTP egress. Local addresses hidden by mDNS are not reported as public IPs.
webrtc.howITellIfThereLeak: How can I tell if there is a leak?
webrtc.differentEgressIndicatesDifferent: Different egress only indicates different UDP and HTTP routes, which may be intentional. Check ISP, region and proxy rules. No public address may mean UDP is blocked or the browser restricted collection; this does not establish safety.
webrtc.howDoIFixALeak: How do I fix a leak?
webrtc.checkUdpForwardingTunTrafficHandl: Check UDP forwarding, TUN traffic handling and IPv6 rules in your client. Firefox can disable media.peerconnection.enabled in about:config; Brave can disable non-proxied UDP. Disabling WebRTC affects video conferencing and similar features, so correcting proxy routing is preferable.
webrtc.whyDoProxyTunModesGiveDifferentRe: Why do proxy and TUN modes give different results?
webrtc.systemProxyVirtualNetworkAdapterM: System proxy and virtual network adapter modes handle different traffic scopes. STUN may be unable to send traffic in some proxy modes, while TUN mode can expose the actual UDP route. Check DNS as well; a single WebRTC result is not a complete privacy audit.

speedtest.methodNotice: Results measure browser-to-Cloudflare HTTP throughput and depend on your proxy, device, and route. Single and multiple requests may reuse HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 connections. Leaving the page or switching to the background stops the test.
